sources.title: FLUX.2 [klein]: Low-Latency AI Image Model
sources.snippet: FLUX.2 [klein] is an image model built for low-latency, interactive creation. It's suited for fast draft-and-refine loops where you want quick feedback while keeping strong photoreal quality, clean composition, and edit-friendly results.
